name: spliteo
description: Track shared expenses, balances, budgets and savings goals in Spliteo.

interface.longDescription:
Spliteo keeps track of the money you share with roommates, partners, friends and travel groups, along with your own spending, budgets and savings goals. With Spliteo in ChatGPT you can:

- Check who owes whom in a group, or across all your groups
- Add shared expenses with even, exact or proportional splits, in any currency
- Get the fewest payments needed to settle a group
- Record personal expenses and income, and see your monthly summary
- Check your budgets and add to savings goals
- See spending by category over any period

Spliteo records money; it never sends or receives payments. You sign in with your Spliteo account and approve access, and you can revoke it anytime from Settings → AI Assistant in the Spliteo app.
defaultPrompt: Who owes me money across my Spliteo groups?
Add a $45 dinner I paid in my Roommates group, split evenly
How am I doing against my budgets this month?

positive.prompt: Who owes me money in Spliteo right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each person the user shares groups with (Sam, Alex) and their net USD balance across all groups, saying who owes whom. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: In Spliteo, add a $60 pizza dinner I paid for in my Roommates group, split evenly between the three of us.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one 60 USD expense in Roommates paid by the user, with the user, Sam and Alex each owing 20, then confirms what was recorded.

positive.prompt: What's the simplest way to settle up my Roommates group in Spliteo?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the fewest payments (who pays whom and how much) that would clear every balance in Roommates. No payment is made and nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: How am I doing against my Spliteo budgets this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each active budget, including the 400 USD monthly Groceries budget, with the amount spent, the amount left and the percentage used.

positive.prompt: Add $100 to my Emergency fund goal in Spliteo.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 100 USD contribution to the Emergency fund goal and reports the new saved amount and progress toward its 2,000 USD target.

negative.description: Sending money is out of scope: Spliteo only records expenses and never moves money

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Montevideo tomorrow?

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Should I put my savings in index funds or crypto?

publication.release_notes: First release: shared balances, group and personal expenses, settle-up suggestions, budgets, savings goals and spending by category.

es-ES.subtitle: Gastos compartidos y finanzas
es-ES.description:
Spliteo lleva la cuenta del dinero que compartes con compañeros de piso, tu pareja, amigos y grupos de viaje, además de tus gastos, presupuestos y metas de ahorro personales. Con Spliteo en ChatGPT puedes:

- Ver quién le debe a quién en un grupo o en todos tus grupos
- Agregar gastos compartidos divididos en partes iguales, por monto o por proporción, en cualquier moneda
- Obtener la menor cantidad de pagos para saldar un grupo
- Registrar gastos e ingresos personales y ver tu resumen del mes
- Revisar tus presupuestos y sumar a tus metas de ahorro
- Ver tus gastos por categoría en cualquier período

Spliteo registra el dinero; nunca envía ni recibe pagos. Inicias sesión con tu cuenta de Spliteo y apruebas el acceso, y puedes revocarlo cuando quieras desde Ajustes → Asistente de IA en la app de Spliteo.
